description: List discussion topics in a course, returning id, title, message, posted_at, discussion_type, published, and is_announcement for each topic — replies are not included. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use get_discussion to fetch one topic in full detail including due/available dates, post_discussion_entry to reply, and list_announcements to see only announcements.
name: list_discussions
title: List Discussions
